text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through 
the Twinkle Series with my partner 
Umamusume would begin. The name of the 
girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
—Assigned Trainer confirmed. Good day, 
Master. I am Mihono Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Objective: Triple Crown Umamusume. This is 
my "will," and my father's dream as well.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
—Preparations for target complete. Please 
proceed with training.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle 
Series with <chrname> began!
